evidence_quote: This study aimed to evaluate the relationships between multi-flow fractional exhaled nitric oxide parameters (FeNO50, FeNO200, and CaNO) and lung function, and to assess their utility in predicting airway hyperresponsiveness (AHR) in this population.
rationale: The study examines airway inflammation, lung function, and prediction of airway hyperresponsiveness in chronic cough patients. It does not address tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
